FINAL ORDER OF APPROVAL
On June 5, 2026, the Office of Financial Regulation ("Office") issued the attached Notice
oflntent to Approve ("NOI") the application by Mrs. Sharon M. France ("Applicant") for approval
for authority to acquire an indirect controlling interest in Commerce Bank & Trust ("Bank"),
Winter Park, Orange County, Florida and Trivergent Trust Company, LLC ("Trust Company"),
Winter Park, Orange County, Florida by directly acquiring a controlling interest in Commerce
National Bankshares of Florida, Inc. On June 5, 2026, the Office received the Applicant's written
waiver of the right to an administrative hearing concerning the Office's intended action.
Accordingly, it is ORDERED:
1. The application is APPROVED, subject to satisfaction of the conditions contained
in the attached NOi.
2. The Applicant must satisfy the conditions of approval specified in the attached NOi.
Until these conditions have been met, or if any interim development is deemed to warrant further
action by the Office, the Office reserves the right to alter, suspend, or withdraw approval.
DONE and ORDERED this ~ day of June, 2026, at Tallahassee, Leon County,

OFR Case No.: 139034
Dear Ms. Buzzerio:
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN pursuant to chapters 655, 658, and sections 120.60 and 120.80,
Florida Statutes, that the Office of Financial Regulation ("Office") has considered the information
presented in the application by Mrs. Sharon M. France ("Applicant" or "Mrs. France") for authority to
acquire an indirect controlling interest Commerce Bank & Trust ("Bank"), Winter Park, Orange County,
Florida and Trivergent Trust Company, LLC ("Trust Company"), Winter Park, Orange County, Florida
by directly acquiring a controlling interest in Commerce National Bankshares of Florida, Inc., and intends
to approve the application based upon the following:
FINDINGS OF FACT
(I) On December 18, 2025, the Applicant filed an application for authority to acquire an indirect
controlling interest in the Bank and the Trust Company.
(2) Notice of the application was published in the Florida Administrative Register on December 24,
2025. No hearing was requested, and none was held.
(3) Commerce National Bankshares of Florida, Inc. ("Bankshares") is a Florida corporation and a
registered bank holding company, located at 1201 South Orlando Avenue, Suite 100, Winter
Park, Florida 32789 and is the parent company of the Bank and the Trust Company. Mrs.
France is seeking approval to acquire approximately 72. 79 percent of the shares of Bankshares.
(4) Commerce Bank & Trust is a state-chartered bank with its main office at 1201 South Orlando
Avenue, Suite 100, Winter Park, Florida 32789. The Bank opened for business on February 3,
2003 under the name Commerce National Bank of Florida, and the Bank currently operates
under the Florida charter number 1234-T and does have trust powers.
(5) Trivergent Trust Company, LLC is a state-chartered trust company with its main office at 1201
South Orlando Avenue, Suite 370, Winter Park, Florida 32789. The Trust Company opened for
business on December 10, 2018 and operates under the Florida charter nwnber 291-T
(6) The Office deemed the application complete on April 16, 2026 with a resulting decision due
date for the application of June 14, 2026.

(7) On or about March 11, 2026, the Applicant filed an application with the Federal Reserve Bank
of Atlanta ("FRB") pursuant to Section 3(a)(3) of the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as
amended.
(8) The Applicant states it will come to own or control at least 2,483,843 or 72.79 percent of the
outstanding shares ofBankshares in exchange for the transfer of assets equivalent to the value
of the shares (approximately $11,674,062.10) to be acquired.
(9) The Applicant's ownership and/or control percentage will exceed 10 percent due to the
following factors:
a. Mrs. France will own or control 72.79 percent of Bankshares as a result of the proposed
transaction
b. Jennifer France Bates is the daughter of Mrs. France and is currently a Director at both
the Bank and Trust Company and also owns approximately 22,500 shares of
Banks hares.
c. As a result of the transaction, Mrs. France and Jennifer France Bates will be considered
a control group.
(10) The Applicant has represented that no changes are planned to the Bank's or the Trust
Company's executive management or to the Board of Directors.
CONCLUSIONS OF LAW
(11) Based upon the information submitted by the Applicant and investigation by the Office, the
Applicant is qualified by reputation, character, experience, and financial responsibility to
control and operate the Bank and the Trust Company in a legal and proper manner and the
interests of the other stockholders, and the depositors and creditors of the Bank and the Trust
Company and the interests of the public generally, will not be jeopardized by the proposed
change in ownership and controlling interest.
Having considered the application, the Office concludes that the application satisfies the criteria of
sections 658.27 and 658.28, Florida Statutes (2025). Consequently, the Office intends to approve this
application subject to the following conditions:
(1) That the FRB approves or otherwise does not object to the proposed transaction, and the
approval is not terminated, rescinded, or otherwise withdrawn regarding the indirect acquisition
of the Bank and the Trust Company.
(2) That the Bank's and the Trust Company's executive management and Board of Directors prior
to the consummation of the transaction, will not subsequently change as a result of the change
of-control application.
(3) That any substantial change in the structure of ownership, whether direct or indirect, or
composition of the Applicant or Bankshares from that described in the application, must be
reported to the Office to determine continued compliance with section 658.28, Florida Statutes.
(4) That, pursuant to section 655.0385(1), Florida Statutes, and Rule 69U-100.03852, Florida
Administrative Code, the Bank and the Trust Company shall notify, and file an application

Daniele Buzzerio
Commerce National Bankshares of Florida, Inc.

with, the Office regarding the proposed appointment of any individual to the board of directors
or the employment of any individual as an executive officer or equivalent position, at least 60
days before such appointment or employment becomes effective. Prior to serving in his/her
proposed capacity, the individual must be approved in writing by the Office. This condition
shall be in effect for two years following the indirect acquisition of the Bank the Trust
Company, or any period in which the Bank and the Trust Company are otherwise required by
the Office to report significant events per section 655.948, Florida Statutes.
(5) That, as a result of this application, the Applicant is authorized to own or control, directly or
indirectly, up to 100 percent of all classes of Bankshares' s outstanding shares of stock, and that
no entity, individual, or group of individuals, other than the Applicant is authorized by this
Notice to directly or indirectly own or control over 9.99 percent or more of the total outstanding
shares of the Bank or the Trust Company's stock as a result of this transaction.
(6) That as a result of the proposed transaction as described in the application, the Office be
provided with copies of any agreements or contracts between Bankshares, the Bank, and/or the
Trust Company and the Applicant or any company, partnership, or other business entity owned
or controlled by the Applicant, or affiliated parties of the Applicant, prior to execution of any
such agreement or the transaction of any business between the signatory parties under the terms
of such agreement for two years following the indirect acquisition of the Bank the Trust
Company.
(7) That the Bank and the Trust Company shall operate within the parameters of their respective
existing business plans. The Bank and the Trust Company shall promptly notify the Office of
any material deviations or changes from its existing business plan and shall submit proposed
revisions to the business plan to the Office for its review. Any revised financial projections
shall reflect the current understanding of costs, competition, interest rate levels and trends, local
demand for the products and services offered, and other factors affecting the performance and
growth of the Bank or the Trust Company. If the Office determines whether the Bank or the
Trust Company has significantly deviated from their respective existing business plans within
one year of the date of a Final Order, a new business plan shall be developed and submitted to
the Office and the appropriate federal regulators for review and concurrence.
(8) That the consummation of the proposed transaction as described in the application conforms to
all requirements of Federal Law and the laws of the State of Florida.
(9) That the Applicant adheres to the requirements set forth in section 655.0386, Florida Statutes.
The Office will issue a conditional Final Order of Approval after the expiration of the 21-day period
contained in the Notice of Rights unless the Applicant elects to waive rights to a hearing by providing
written notification of such waiver to the Office. Before all the conditions specified above and other
reasonable requirements of the Office have been fulfilled, or if any interim development is deemed by the
Office to warrant such action, the Office retains the right to alter, suspend, or withdraw approval of the
indirect change in control of the Bank and the Trust Company. This approval shall expire six months
from the date of the Final Order, unless the Office has granted a request for an extension of time for good
cause shown.
In taking this action, the Office has relied on the representations and commitments made by the Applicant
in the application and all supplemental information submitted. Every effort should be made to meet these
representations and commitments. Please keep the Office advised of the steps being taken to comply with
the conditions imposed in this Notice.

A FINAL ORDER MAY BE ENTERED WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE.
In the event that a hearing is requested, all parties will have the right to be represented by counsel
or other qualified representative, to offer written and oral testimony, to call and cross-examine
witnesses, and to have subpoenas and subpoenas duces tecum issued on their behalf. Pursuant to
Section 120.573, Florida Statutes, you are advised that mediation of this matter is not available.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, persons with disabilities needing a
special accommodation to participate in this proceeding should contact the Agency Clerk no later
than seven (7) days prior to the filing deadline or proceeding, at the Office of Financial
Regulation, The Fletcher Building, 101 East Gaines Street, Tallahassee, Florida 32399-0379,
Phone: (850) 410-9889, or by Email: agency.clerk@flofr.gov.
